questions.question: Momentum depends on which two quantities?
At the same speed, which has more momentum?
questions.explanation: The loaded truck has much greater mass.

questions.question: A faster object of the same mass has more momentum.
Momentum depends only on velocity.
questions.explanation: Momentum depends on both mass and velocity.

questions.question: Momentum = mass × ________.
questions.explanation: Momentum is calculated from mass and velocity.

questions.question: Why is a fast heavy vehicle harder to stop than a slow light object?
questions.correctAnswer: A good answer mentions both mass and velocity producing larger momentum.
questions.explanation: The heavy fast vehicle has much more momentum, so a larger impulse is needed to stop it.
